HUMAN SCALE / Inner perception & dreams

Psychometry.

A practice in which impressions about an object or its associations are recorded while holding or observing it.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Psychometry
Psicometría de objetos

Reported impressions about an object’s history or associations, attributed by practitioners to contact with the object.

Psychometrics
Psicometría psicológica

The measurement of psychological characteristics; a separate meaning of a similar word.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Here psychometry has its parapsychological meaning, distinct from psychometrics and psychological measurement. Nineteenth-century accounts are historical testimony to the practice and its claims.

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Have an object selected without sharing its history.
  2. Record sensations, images and guesses before asking for provenance.
  3. Compare the complete record with documented information, keeping known clues visible in the account.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Photograph the whole object against a plain background and add a close view of its surface.
  • Send the impressions and provenance as separate records, with ownership details redacted.

POTPOURRI / PERSONAL INTERPRETATION

Share a photograph or a record.

A photograph, drawing or dated record can be sent privately for a personal reading. Include the procedure and the question.
